g.text: A moderated photo guestbook. Visitors send a postcard, the owner reviews it, and only
approved moments become part of the public wall.
Pending content is never public; the review boundary is the product.
Uploaded photos live in private R2; derived views are served.
The studio link never grants API permission to a guest.
The public wall and review studio · real capture
A visitor sends a photo postcard.
The owner inspects, hides or deletes.
Only reviewed items cross the boundary.
The public wall reads approved records.
